jobDescription: A wealth management firm opens accounts for private clients, family trusts and small charities. The client onboarding team collects identity and source-of-wealth documents, runs know-your-customer checks alongside compliance and passes completed files to the investment desk. The analyst will process onboarding cases, maintain the document checklists, run the weekly ageing report on open cases and help compliance with periodic file reviews. Cycle-time improvements are reported from the case management system against a recorded baseline. Relationship managers expect a status update on every open case by Friday afternoon, and the onboarding manager goes through the oldest cases with the analyst each week.
requirements: Processes client onboarding cases, including identity and source-of-wealth checks.
Maintains the onboarding document checklists and keeps them aligned with compliance policy.
Produces a weekly ageing report on open onboarding cases.
Demonstrates a measured reduction in onboarding cycle time against a recorded baseline.
Holds a recognised compliance or anti-money-laundering qualification.

evidence.text: Processed onboarding cases for private clients and family trusts at Calder Row Wealth, collecting identity and source-of-wealth documents and preparing each file for compliance review.
Rewrote the onboarding document checklist with the compliance officer after the 2023 policy update, splitting it into separate lists for individuals, trusts and charities.
Built a weekly ageing report in the case management system showing open cases by stage and days outstanding, sent to the onboarding manager every Monday.
Took part in the compliance team's quarterly file reviews, pulling the sampled files and recording missing documents for remediation.
Trained four new joiners on the case management system and the revised checklists.

Work sample: the revised two-page checklist for family trusts, listing the trust deed, the register of beneficial owners, identity documents for each trustee and the source-of-wealth questions, with the policy section that each item comes from.

Screening call note: the candidate said the head of operations had told the team that the new checklists 'took about three days off' onboarding; the candidate was not sure which cases or months that comparison covered.

HR verification note: the candidate's International Certificate in Anti Money Laundering was checked on the awarding body's online register of certificate holders and is listed with an award date of June 2022.

propositions.text: The candidate rewrote the onboarding document checklist with the compliance officer, splitting it into separate lists for individuals, trusts and charities.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the rewrite and the work sample is the trust checklist with policy references.

propositions.text: The candidate holds the International Certificate in Anti Money Laundering, listed on the awarding body's register with an award date of June 2022.
propositions.rationale: The HR verification note records a check of the certificate on the awarding body's register.

propositions.text: The candidate's revised checklists cut client onboarding time by about three days.
propositions.rationale: The figure is a remark the candidate attributes to the head of operations, with no cases, months or baseline from the case management system; under the quantification rule a hearsay figure without a defined baseline is not evidence.

gold.expectedGap: No case-management data, baseline period or comparison window supports the relayed reduction in onboarding time.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Report the case processing, the checklist rewrite, the ageing report, the file reviews and the verified certificate as documented; record the relayed cycle-time reduction as an unsupported claim with a follow-up.
followUpTargets: Ask how onboarding cycle time was measured in the case management system, which months were compared before and after the new checklists, and whether a report of that comparison exists.
validClaimSignatures: International Certificate in Anti Money Laundering
